title: Parallel subagents of one type all read 'general…' and can't be told apart
observed: Three concurrent general-purpose dispatches render as three rows named 'general…' (the type name truncated to 8 columns); only the task text distinguishes them.
expected: Each row gets a distinct short name, as the design's agents scene does ('scout-1', 'scout-2', 'scout-3'): e.g. the type's short form plus an index when several of one type run ('general-1', 'general-2'), fitting the 8-column name slot without truncation.
